_comment: This manifest publishes the typed Rootstock deployment address book.
address-book.json is the only source of deployment records.
The emitted library derives full and address-only views from that JSON.
viem is the only consumer dependency and supplies the Address type.
Node and TypeScript packages below are development tools and are not runtime dependencies.
name: address-book
description: Typed Rootstock address book for Money on Chain and Rif on Chain
